cat01_sensitivity.definition: count of unordered bin pairs holding a forbidden category pair at 3-D Euclidean distance < radius (inclusive boundary: d + 1e-9 >= radius passes), computed by my own full O(N^2) scan over all assignments, not the validator's spatial hash
cat01_sensitivity.note: The as-supplied baseline is infeasible only because the radius is 10 m: at 5 m 169 pairs still violate, at 2 m none do. The validator's own count at 10 m (1071) equals my independent count exactly; the validator evaluated 3594 forbidden pairs inside its 3-D neighbourhood window, my full scan sees 114,986 forbidden pairs in total.
cat01_sensitivity.validator_coverage_caveat: The validator's spatial hash only evaluates forbidden pairs whose cells differ by at most 1 per axis, which is sound (any pair closer than R must fall in adjacent cells) but makes checks_run an under-count of CAT-01 coverage: the optimized layout records ZERO CAT-01 checks (its closest forbidden pair is 27.2 m, so no pair enters the window) and the repaired baseline records 1039. The 0-violation CAT-01 verdict for the optimized layout therefore rests on my full 95,400-pair scan, not on the validator's window count.

findings.title: The as-supplied canonical baseline is genuinely infeasible at 10 m, and only at 10 m
findings.evidence: 1071 CAT-01 pairs (min 3.2 m); 169 pairs < 5 m; 0 pairs < 2 m; all 1071 are severity=high; 71 of 1200 SKUs are implicated (assignment feasibility 94.08 %).
findings.impact: Any claim that the supplied layout is feasible is false; the pipeline correctly reports it as diagnostic_baseline/INFEASIBLE.

findings.title: The published comparison baseline is a feasibility-repaired layout, not the supplied one
findings.evidence: baseline_variant=repaired_minimal; 96/1425 records moved (6.737 %, 1471.373 m total, median 12.01 m, max 36.003 m), objective disabled, 0 rejected moves; the as-supplied metrics appear only under diagnostic_baseline with diagnostic_only=true.
findings.impact: Both published layouts are feasible, so the comparison is valid evidence as labelled, but 'the baseline is feasible' must always be qualified as 'the repaired baseline'. The improvement against the as-supplied layout is -56.06 %, i.e. the published -55.65 % is conservative.

findings.title: The result is deterministic and fully reproducible
findings.evidence: Independent reruns of prepare_baseline_variant, run_phase5 and run_phase6 produced byte-identical assignments (17380197..., 1269e111...) and an identical 18-row comparison table; a full CLI run-all in a sandbox reproduced 18/18 delivered artifact files byte-for-byte, with only wall-clock runtime fields differing.
findings.impact: No run-order or hidden-state dependency was found in the delivered evidence.

findings.title: Structural limit schema: Phase 1 added derived beam/level caps and redefined shelf_max; the derivation is undocumented in the Phase-1 note
findings.evidence: locations.csv vs locations.csv.bak-pre-limits: 2304/2304 rows differ only in shelf_max_weight_kg (uniform factor 2.88) plus two added columns beam_max_weight_kg, level_max_weight_kg. Geometry (x,y,z), width/height/depth, max_weight_kg, usable_volume_cm3 and rack_max_weight_kg are identical on all rows. The current values are systematically derived from the unchanged per-bin cap: beam = 0.90 x (2 bins), level = shelf_max = 0.72 x (4 bins) = 2.88 x bin cap, rack = 0.85 x summed beam caps (2304/2304 rows match; src/data_processing/generate.py STRUCTURAL_FACTORS = beam 0.90 / level 0.80 / rack 0.85). In the backup, shelf_max_weight_kg equalled max_weight_kg on every row, i.e. it was a per-bin duplicate before being redefined as the level alias. Dataset validation: ok, hard_errors 0.
findings.impact: The 0-violation structural result is valid under the current schema because both the validator and the optimizer read these fields, and they are internally coherent. But the magnitudes are a Phase-1 construction, and PHASE_1_BASELINE_VERIFICATION.md SS E.5 records only 'two fields added', not the derating factors or the shelf_max redefinition. P2-5/status docs should document the derivation and the fact that shelf_max is now a level alias.
